bugs_found: compound_interest allows negative principal while other money entrypoints reject negative amounts
compound_interest/loan_payment silently truncate fractional years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), producing wrong financial results instead of rejecting invalid periods
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal and can mix float with Decimal balances, causing TypeError or precision/semantic inconsistency depending on caller input
transfer mutates debit before credit; if credit assignment/addition fails on a hostile or malformed account_to object, funds are debited without atomic rollback
fx_convert accepts missing/negative/zero/non-finite exchange rates because only amount is validated, enabling negative or invalid converted money
